run_main_convert_spider_to_allegro: run the main function to convert Spider retarget outputs to Allegro robot data format
run_main_with_custom_dataset: run main with a custom dataset name and task to export wrist and object poses
run_main_bimanual_extraction: run main in bimanual mode to extract both left and right wrist and joint positions
run_main_kinematic_data: run main with kinematic data type to process trajectory without control signals
run_main_custom_output_dir: run main with a custom output directory to save the converted robot data
